title: Sourness
paragraphs: “This method was inspired by what the previous Gaelion did as a last resort, something the Spear Hero mentioned before.”
“Huh?”
Father furrowed his brows, voicing my thoughts. I felt an ominous, filthy sensation crawling all over me!

“With just a fragment of the Dragon Emperor’s power, the previous Gaelion could barely store her memories in the spear… Memories of when a savage adventurer invaded the nest, when Big Sis was crying, and how Naofumi saved her… those days were vividly preserved…” Rival spoke dreamily.
I want to punch her so badly…

“The previous Gaelion, fearing that these feelings might be lost, poured her hidden emotions into the spear, breached a powerful barrier, and secured space for her memories. She entrusted her will to the current Gaelion, who pursued the same goal, and it was accomplished!”
“Uwaaahhh! Disgusting! Die already!”
Rival’s memories are inside my spear!? Such a vile and revolting thing is impossible to comprehend!
“Mo-Motoyasu-kun, calm down!”
Father restrained me from behind. But there’s no way I can hold back!
“Calm down, Motoyasu!”
“Oh dear…”
The elder sister sounded troubled, but I’m the one who’s truly troubled here. Something so filthy is inside my spear! How do I get rid of something so disgusting!?
“Gaelion inherited the previous Gaelion’s memories and grew to love Naofumi even more, only to be treated like this! That’s why she wants to loop again!”
“Die, you fiend!”
“Even if I’m a fiend, Gaelion loves Naofumi!”
“But… in a way, this might be an opportunity.”
“What!?” Father asked Itsuki while still restraining me.
“Because Motoyasu-san is terrible at explaining things and tends to forget important stuff. Wouldn’t Gaelion be able to provide clearer explanations?”
“That’s a piece of cake! Leave it to me!”
“But… it’s Gaelion, you know?” Ren interjected.
Exactly.
This damn dragon is going to explain things on my behalf to Father and the others?
I can’t help but scoff at that!
“Do you have a problem with that!? With a fragment of the Dragon Emperor’s power, Gaelion can even achieve a class-up beyond the limit!”
Then, Rival turned to Assistant, who was staring blankly, and waved her hand as if trying to act elegant.

“That’s the plan. Big Sis will spend the next loop living leisurely with Dad in the nest and territory, while Gaelion will join Naofumi and the others in the battle for world peace. That’s how it’s going to be!”
I can’t help but feel like she’s mocking us. More than that, why is she being so reckless?
“Hmm… It’s nice that I can be with Dad, but something doesn’t sit right.”
Assistant frowned and glared at Rival.
“How should I put it… It feels like her true colors are showing… It does seem convenient, though.”

“No, it’s not just about her memory and knowledge. Since it’s filtered through Gaelion’s perspective, wouldn’t it be difficult to grasp? Besides, knowing her, Gaelion will probably demand something from Naofumi in return.”
“Ah, like offering future knowledge in exchange for his virginity, or something along those lines.”
“Of course! Gaelion won’t give up! Just like the Spear Hero!”
“Ugh…”
Father was also visibly disturbed. I was in even greater despair. I want to kill this thing right now! No, wait… killing her wouldn’t work. Then, what should I do?

That’s it. The only way for me to prevent Rival from showing up in the next loop is to make sure Father gets involved with someone before she appears! I can’t afford not to recruit Assistant and the weakest Dragon Emperor in the next loop! But it took me a long time to reach this conclusion as I continued to be confused.
“Motoyasu-sama, please calm down!”
Yuki-chan, Kou, and the Filolials finally managed to calm me down. But how am I supposed to save the world with this filthy spear?
“For now, if there’s another loop, Naofumi’s suffering is guaranteed, isn’t it?”
“Good or bad… I’m not sure.”
“Next time, I’ll definitely win over Naofumi with a big-breasted older sister character!”

Rival’s determined words echoed in my mind. As my spirit took tremendous damage, the days of peaceful busyness passed. Even in the Nosferatu Great Forest, Filo-tan was nowhere to be found. The Phoenix was easily defeated by Father and the others, and the Kirin was similarly dealt with in a single day. Then, the waves resumed. Under the guidance of the elder sister, I continued raising slaves and Filolials, but still, Filo-tan could not be found.

When even the knowledge from the first world had become unreliable, I started calculating the days and realized… aren’t we approaching the same point as in the first world? However, unlike the first world, there are almost no individuals chosen by the Seven Star Weapons. Thanks to Father and the others raising soldiers and Filolials of various countries to their limits, we were now able to easily quell the waves.
“Looks like Motoyasu-kun has exhausted all his future knowledge.”
“Indeed.”
“That’s a relief.”
“At least we won’t be tossed around by Motoyasu’s knowledge anymore.”

And yet… something feels off. The further we progress, the more my memories become hazy. I remember something about going to the sanctuary of the Filolials… but it’s all so vague. How did we get there? By the way, the wave is set to occur in just a few hours. It’s the last wave I can remember… and I’m worried. Currently, we are resting in the hero’s quarters prepared by Faubrey.
“Naofumi-chan, can you give me something for nausea? I drank too much. I’m feeling a little sick.”
“Sadeena-san, you were drinking quite a lot with Larsa last night.”
The slightly drunk elder sister leaned against Father as she spoke.
“Ugh… I feel sick…”

Panda seemed to be in the same state. She went off to throw up. By the way, Panda was all dressed up and had been getting compliments from the village slaves, calling her cute. It seems Father and the elder sister have completely finished her transformation.
“Ahh, I feel like eating that sour thing you made the other day. It feels like it helps with hangovers.”
“Got it. I’ll get it ready right away. We have a wave coming up today, so we need to be ready to fight properly.”

Father began preparing the food. We’re in an environment where Father cooks for us every day using the fresh ingredients provided by Faubrey. At that moment, Ren and Itsuki started whispering while watching Panda and the elder sister. Then, they cautiously called out to Panda.
“Hey.”
“Hmm? What is it?”
“You’ve been getting hangover remedies from Naofumi for days now… but doesn’t that mean…”
“Even Sadeena-san, who can usually handle her liquor, right?”
“Oh my?”
“Eh? W-What’s that supposed to mean?”
“If you’ve been having drinking parties with Naofumi every night, it’d be strange if nothing happened, wouldn’t it?”
The elder sister touched her cheek, looking a little embarrassed, while Panda gradually turned pale.
“So that’s why you’ve been looking more radiant and gentle lately!”

Panda’s subordinates, whom we hadn’t heard from in a while, started causing a commotion. Well, they had been noisy before, but it hadn’t reached my ears. For some reason, Ren and Itsuki started clapping, and hearing the noise, Éclair, Assistant, Mole, and the others living with us gathered around.
“Congratulations.”
“Congratulations.”
“Congratulations. What are we celebrating?”
“Sadeena-san and Larsa-san are expecting.”
“Oh! Is that true? Congratulations!”
“Don’t start celebrating on your own! Ugh, I just have a bad hangover!”
Should I join in? Father looks so happy and embarrassed.
“Congratulations!”
“Stoooop celebrating without permission!”
“Oh my? What should we do now, Naofumi-chan?”
“Hmm. I guess Sadeena-san and Larsa-san should step back from the front lines and take care of their bodies for now?”
“It’s not certain yet, so it’s fine. Though… nothing’s come, that’s true.”
At that moment, Panda turned even paler.
“Come to think of it, I haven’t had mine either! Could it really be…?”
But Panda quickly regained her composure.
“Tch… If that’s how it is, then I guess there’s no helping it… If it’s a hero’s child, it’s not a bad thing.”
“For now, it’s not confirmed, but what about names?”
“What do you want to do, Sadeena-san? Larsa-san?”
“Hmm… Maybe I’ll borrow a name from Raphtalia-chan?”
“That might be nice.”
“I’ll decide when the time comes.”
And so, those peaceful days passed by.
